scope: District-linked public activity and statements since 2023; separate from the 5 Aug–5 Nov 2026 archive
method: The district field denotes the constituency/subject or the public event location as reported. A parliamentary question or press statement does not prove physical presence or completed works. Verify supporting source.

records.title: Kondagaon campaign: Markam’s reported village outreach amid tribal concerns
records.summary: A November 2023 political profile reports Markam's constituency campaign and tribal grievances. Campaign activity is not evidence of completed public works.

records.title: Baij joins Hasdeo forest demonstration opposing Parsa coal mining
records.summary: Report describes Baij joining a protest at Hariharpur, Surguja, calling for protection of forest rights and opposing mining. Statements are attributed claims, not independently verified findings.

records.title: Korba MP report card: questions, MPLADS proposals and mining-displacement demands
records.summary: Report describes Jyotsna Mahant raising displacement/rehabilitation issues linked to SECL mines, railway and hospital requests, and proposed MPLADS works. Progress figures are a 2024 snapshot; proposals must not be read as completed projects.

records.title: Netam raises proposal for multipurpose sports hall in Farsgaon, Kondagaon
records.summary: Official Rajya Sabha debate records her request for a multipurpose hall at Farsgaon in Kondagaon district and archery support for indigenous and tribal sports. This is a parliamentary demand, not a completed construction.

records.title: Baghel leads Durg demonstration after MLA Devendra Yadav’s arrest
records.summary: Published report says Baghel led a Congress protest in Durg demanding a probe into the Baloda Bazar case. Allegations voiced by political leaders remain allegations.

records.title: Mahant leads Sakti protest as Congress demands inquiry into Baloda Bazar case
records.summary: Report identifies the Leader of the Opposition as leading the Congress protest in Sakti district. This is evidence of a reported public political event, not of development delivery.
records.verification: Published 25 Aug 2024, referring to 24 Aug demonstration

records.title: Baij joins Raipur opposition protest over Baloda Bazar arrests
records.summary: Report says Congress president Baij led a public protest in Raipur. This is location of a public rally, not evidence of travel monitoring.
records.verification: Published 25 Aug 2024; public event reported for 24 Aug

records.title: Baloda Bazar farmers approach MLA Sandeep Sahu about irrigation reservoir water
records.summary: NDTV MP-CG video reports local farmers asking Sandeep Sahu for irrigation supplies from Balar reservoir. It documents a request, not confirmed water allocation.

records.title: Patel questions Raigarh land acquisition and compensation figures in Assembly
records.summary: Report describes Patel challenging official figures and asking about land acquisition/compensation for National Highway 200 in Raigarh district. Legislative questions are not evidence of compensation paid.

records.title: Deepak Baij completes Dantewada Nyay Padyatra opposing private iron-ore allotments
records.summary: PTI reports Baij leading the four-day Kirandul–Dantewada foot march, with Congress demanding cancellation of several private mine allotments. Claims about leases are party statements; march is reported to have occurred.

records.title: Bhilai MLA meets constituents at Sector 5 office about local grievances
records.summary: Report describes a public constituency meeting at the MLA office in Bhilai where residents raised local concerns. No independent record of grievance resolution is included.

records.title: Patel joins Kharsia villagers’ protest over deteriorated roads
records.summary: Amar Ujala documents Umesh Patel joining a road-condition protest with residents from villages in Kharsia. Report indicates officials were approached; the article headline claims demands met, which requires confirmation of completed road repairs.

records.title: Kharsia farmers protest fertiliser shortage under Umesh Patel’s leadership
records.summary: Local report describes a gherao of Kharsia tehsil office over fertiliser supply, led by Patel and Congress workers. This is reported collective action, not proof of supply restoration.

records.title: Singh Deo disputes government account of delayed Ambikapur medical college hospital
records.summary: Singh Deo and state ministers traded accusations over the delayed hospital project. Singh Deo argued the government should account for its own time in office; this records a public policy response, not completed construction.
